YOUR STUDIO, YOUR COMPUTER

Keep it local.

VoxCPM2 runs on your computer. No voice API, no subscription.

Local AI engine

Checking connection…

Download the compact 4-bit VoxCPM2 model once. Speech and voice cloning run in your browser using WebGPU. Your text and reference clips stay on your device.

  1. Download the local app package.
  2. Run ./start-python.sh in the extracted folder.
  3. Open http://127.0.0.1:8765.
  4. Click “Download & load model” below.

Use a current Chrome or Edge browser with WebGPU and shader-f16. The Python service remains available as an alternative.

A few things to know

Your data stays with you.
In browser mode, scripts and reference audio never leave the browser. Initial setup downloads model files from Hugging Face.

30 languages, one studio.
Includes Khmer, English, French, Thai, Chinese, Japanese, and more. Language is detected from the script.

Make something original.
Clone your own voice or a voice you have permission to use. Label shared audio as AI-generated.
